# 金剛經疏

**ID:** T2737
**Volume:** T85
**Category:** 般若部類,敦煌寫本部類
**Original Category:** 古逸部
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T2737

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

An **anonymous one-juan *Vajracchedikā* commentary** recovered from the **Dūnhuáng cache** and preserved as T85 no. 2737. Authorship is not preserved either in the manuscript itself or in catalog tradition; the catalog meta accordingly lists no `persons` field. The text breaks off mid-passage at the surviving fragment's boundaries, suggesting it is a partial witness of a longer original work. *notBefore* / *notAfter* set very broadly (**600–900**) since neither author nor date is established; Sui-Táng provenance is generally assumed for Dūnhuáng *Vajracchedikā* commentary manuscripts. Catalog dynasty 唐.

**Abstract**

The surviving fragment opens in the middle of the commentary on the **second-fruit (Skt. *sakṛdāgāmin*)** passage of the sūtra: *Sùpútí, yú yì yún hé, sītuóhán néng zuò shì niàn, wǒ dé sītuóhán guǒ bù?* (Section 9 of the Liáng Zhāomíng division). The commentator parses the sūtra as a sequence of *Sùpútí*'s questions and the Buddha's responses, with each *fruit* (*xūtuóhuán*, *sītuóhán*, *ānuóhán*, *āluóhàn*) treated separately. The annotation is structural-doctrinal in the standard mid-Táng manner, using the *Sìfēn lǜ* schema for the four fruits and indexing each to the corresponding *fánnǎo* (afflictions) cut by it (*sītuóhán* = *bó tānchēn* 薄貪嗔, the diminishing of greed-anger, etc.). The work is one of three undated and anonymous Dūnhuáng *Jīngāng jīng shū* in T85 (cf. [KR6c0110](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0110) T85 no. 2738; [KR6c0111](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0111) T85 no. 2739, the latter an *interlinear annotation* edition).
